Elena / Tessa / Jonas —

Following up with the artifacts and a short mapping note. Attached: SOC2-report-2026.pdf and a SIG/CAIQ mapping worksheet (sig-mapping-worksheet.xlsx). Quick notes:

- SOC2: latest Type II (period: Jan–Jun 2026). Redacted production IPs; contact me if Acme needs unredacted evidence via secure transfer.
- CAIQ mapping: I filled out the critical sections we expect Acme to review (IAM, data residency, encryption in transit, incident response). The worksheet has column "portal fragment" that maps our answers to OneTrust QIDs.
- Evidence rotation: default TTL for artifacts is 12 months; we can support a 6-month cadence for heightened audits.

Attachment stubs:
- SOC2-report-2026.pdf (pdf)
- sig-mapping-worksheet.xlsx (xlsx)

Open items for the sync:
- Whether Acme needs SAML-based SSO for the shadow account or simple email invites.
- Any scoped evidence (e.g., dedicated VPC proofs) that should be separated.

I’ll be on the 10am PT call tomorrow.

Thanks,

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: OneTrust shadow account + CAIQ mapping for Redwood

Onetrust Ops / Elena —

Per our sync just now: we will provision a shadow (observer) account scoped to the Acme tenant. Implementation notes:
- Account type: observer, no write permissions to Acme's master data; upload rights limited to a dedicated "vendor uploads" folder.
- Access: we can support SSO (SAML) or invite by email. For speed, invite-by-email is fastest; SAML requires a short metadata exchange.
- TTL & retention: vendor uploads will have a default 12-month retention; we will tag files with an expiration date and create a monthly rotation job to notify owners 30/7 days before expiry.

Action items assigned:
- OneTrust Ops: create observer account and share invite link + admin contact.
- Tessa / Mina: confirm whether Acme prefers SAML or email invites.
- Jonas: provide the "onetrust-shadow-access-instructions.txt" playbook with steps we use for future vendor requests.

I’m attaching a short playbook (attachment stub included).

— Jonas
Sr. Platform Engineer — Redwood Inference
